items.question: What kinds of automation projects do you handle?
items.answer: We work across hardware and software environments: robotics, sensors, lab systems, industrial workflows, AI agents, dashboards, simulations, and custom integrations.

items.question: Can you work with existing equipment and software?
items.answer: Yes. Many projects start by connecting existing machines, data sources, internal tools, and operator workflows before adding new hardware or software.

items.question: Do you still support precision manufacturing and 3D printing?
items.answer: Yes. OWL precision manufacturing background remains useful for prototypes, fixtures, microfluidics, advanced components, and automation systems that need physical parts.

items.question: Do you handle secure file exchanges?
items.answer: Yes. We can work with NDAs, secure file exchange requirements, and physical drive transfers when project sensitivity requires it.

items.question: What is a typical first engagement?
items.answer: Most projects begin with a focused discovery review of the current system, automation target, constraints, and a practical first milestone.

items.question: Which industries do you serve?
items.answer: We serve technical teams in manufacturing, laboratories, biotech, medical devices, semiconductor, aerospace, automotive, and research and development.

early.title: Precision Roots
early.description: Founded by Nick Liverman in 2012, Old World Labs began with ultra-precise 3D printing and demanding industrial hardware. That foundation still shapes our automation work today.

founder.name: 关于Nick Liverman
founder.background: 12岁开始制作机器人，从编写计算机脚本自动化在线游戏中的采矿和物品制作开始。这些早期经验激发了他将数字对象转化为物理产品的兴趣。
founder.vision: Nick founded Old World Laboratories to build tools that could move between digital design and physical production. That same systems mindset now drives OWL work in AI automation, robotics, and connected software.

events.title: CES上的OWL Nano首秀
details: Old World Labs在CES 2014上发布OWL Nano打印机
OWL Nano是一款使用激光固化液态树脂的立体光刻打印机
使用单丝激光束实现最小变形
能够以惊人的0.1微米层高进行SLA打印
定位为Formlabs Form1打印机的强大竞争对手
专利申请中的技术
OWL作为行业领导者参与CES首个专用3D打印区域

events.title: MC打印机系列和专利
details: 在CES 2015上发布SLA MC-1和MC-2打印机
使用双光子聚合实现创新的100纳米分辨率
启动打印机订阅服务模式
在NASA、斯坦福等主要机构使用
MC-1：美国手工制造的高精度光子纳米制造设备
MC-2：具有改进多激光器的高级控制板，用于新材料
分辨率是行业其他3D打印机的250倍
与美国国防部和集成光子研究所合作
订阅模式允许随技术进步升级硬件
获得使用多波长激光器和光捕获的高级立体光刻系统专利
